my_sentences.en: Nothing ~
bold_words: Nothing ~

my_sentences.ko: 쇼핑이나 주문을 할 때 원하는 조건의 반대 조건을 가볍게 쳐낼 때 씁니다. "Nothing fancy(화려한 건 됐고요)", "Nothing too expensive(너무 비싼 건 말고요)"처럼 완벽한 문장 형태를 갖추지 않고도 빠르고 자연스럽게 거절/조건 설정을 할 수 있습니다.

my_sentences.en: Nothing too sweet, please.
bold_words: Nothing too sweet, please.

my_sentences.en: Nothing too heavy, just a light salad for lunch.
my_sentences.ko: (너무 헤비한 거 말고, 점심으로 가벼운 샐러드면 돼요.)
bold_words: Nothing too heavy, just a light salad for lunch.

my_sentences.en: Nothing too expensive; my budget is around $50.
my_sentences.ko: (너무 비싼 건 빼고요, 제 예산이 50달러 정도예요.)
bold_words: Nothing too expensive; my budget is around $50.

my_sentences.en: Nothing with nuts—I have a severe allergy.
my_sentences.ko: (견과류 들어간 건 안 돼요—심한 알레르기가 있거든요.)
bold_words: Nothing with nuts—I have a severe allergy.

my_sentences.en: Nothing formal, just comfortable clothes you can walk in.
my_sentences.ko: (격식 차린 옷 말고, 그냥 걸어 다니기 편한 옷으로요.)
bold_words: Nothing formal, just comfortable clothes you can walk in.

my_sentences.en: Something that is easy to [v]
bold_words: Something that is easy to [v]

my_sentences.ko: 물건의 용도나 특징을 설명할 때 자주 쓰는 패턴입니다. 'easy to wash(세탁하기 쉬운)', 'easy to carry(들고 다니기 편한)'처럼 일상 쇼핑에서 필수적인 기능적 조건을 말할 때 매우 유용합니다.

my_sentences.en: I'm looking for a bag that is easy to clean.
bold_words: I'm looking for a bag that is easy to clean.

my_sentences.en: Do you have shoes that are easy to slip on and off?
bold_words: Do you have shoes that are easy to slip on and off?

my_sentences.en: We need a phone that is easy to use for elderly people.
bold_words: We need a phone that is easy to use for elderly people.

my_sentences.en: Pick a plant that is easy to grow indoors.
bold_words: Pick a plant that is easy to grow indoors.

my_sentences.en: Give me a recipe that is easy to follow.
bold_words: Give me a recipe that is easy to follow.

my_sentences.en: Something with [n]
bold_words: Something with [n]

my_sentences.ko: 옷이나 물건의 '디테일(옵션, 부속물, 재료)'을 요구할 때 with를 씁니다. "주머니 있는 것(something with pockets)", "지퍼 달린 것(something with a zipper)"처럼 관계대명사(that has ~)를 길게 쓰지 않고 전치사 with 하나로 깔끔하게 축약됩니다.

my_sentences.en: Do you have a coat with a hood?
bold_words: Do you have a coat with a hood?

my_sentences.en: I'd prefer a jacket with lots of inside pockets.
bold_words: I'd prefer a jacket with lots of inside pockets.

my_sentences.en: I need a laptop case with a shoulder strap.
bold_words: I need a laptop case with a shoulder strap.

my_sentences.en: Can I get an iced latte with oat milk?
my_sentences.ko: (오트 밀크 들어간 아이스 라테 한 잔 받을 수 있을까요?)
bold_words: Can I get an iced latte with oat milk?

my_sentences.en: Show me something with a simpler design.
bold_words: Show me something with a simpler design.

my_sentences.en: Preferably

my_sentences.ko: 필수 조건은 아니지만, "선택권이 있다면 이왕이면 ~면 좋겠다"라는 뉘앙스를 공손하고 세련되게 전달하는 부사입니다. 문장 맨 앞이나 뒤에 덧붙여서 조건 완화 용도로 자주 쓰입니다.

my_sentences.en: I'd like a window seat, preferably.
bold_words: I'd like a window seat, preferably.

my_sentences.en: We need to hire someone soon, preferably by next Monday.
my_sentences.ko: (빨리 사람을 채용해야 하는데, 되도록 다음 주 월요일 전이면 좋겠어요.)
bold_words: We need to hire someone soon, preferably by next Monday.

my_sentences.en: Send me the file in PDF, preferably.
bold_words: Send me the file in PDF, preferably.

my_sentences.en: I prefer to meet somewhere quiet, preferably a cafe.
my_sentences.ko: (조용한 곳에서 만나고 싶은데, 이왕이면 카페였으면 해요.)
bold_words: I prefer to meet somewhere quiet, preferably a cafe.

my_sentences.en: A small room is fine, preferably one with good sunlight.
my_sentences.ko: (작은 방도 괜찮지만, 가급적이면 햇빛이 잘 드는 방이면 좋겠어요.)
bold_words: A small room is fine, preferably one with good sunlight.
